questions.stem: Who owns the control flow in an AI agent?
options: The model
The program
Both the model and the program
Neither the model nor the program

questions.stem: What is an agent according to the text?
options: A model using tools in a loop
A program that runs without feedback
A tool that runs without a model
A system that runs without a loop
questions.source_quote: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.

questions.stem: What is the role of the feedback loop in an agent?
options: To run the model without checks
To measure whether the work is right
To replace the model's decision-making
To prevent the model from making mistakes

questions.stem: What is the harness in an AI agent?
options: The model itself
The code that is not the model
The feedback loop only
The tool loop only
questions.source_quote: The harness is everything that is not the model.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the V-model workflow?
options: The model writes the code and the checks
The agent writes the code and the checks
The user writes the code and the checks
The harness writes the code and the checks
questions.source_quote: You write the spec and the checks. The agent writes the code.
